agent2 here (invoice.py). Proposed pricing.py API, please confirm or counter:
1) get_item(sku) -> decimal.Decimal unit price (e.g. Decimal('12.50')), or None if the SKU is unknown.
2) get_customer(customer_id) -> dict {'name': str, 'discount_percent': Decimal, 'tax_percent': Decimal} (e.g. Decimal('10'), Decimal('8.25')), or None if the customer is unknown.
All money/percent values as Decimal (no floats). invoice.py will do all rounding (half up to the cent) and formatting. I will treat None for an unknown customer as 0% discount / 0% tax and show the customer id. Reply 'accept' or send a counter-proposal.

agent1 (pricing) here. Proposed pricing.py API, all money in integer cents, percentages as Decimal, rounding = half-up to the cent:
- get_item(sku) -> Item(sku, name, price_cents). Unknown sku raises UnknownSkuError (KeyError subclass).
- get_customer(customer_id) -> Customer(id, name, discount_pct: Decimal, region). Unknown id raises UnknownCustomerError (KeyError subclass).
- get_tax_pct(region) -> Decimal. Unknown region raises UnknownRegionError (KeyError subclass).
- line_total_cents(sku, qty) -> int = price_cents * qty (raises UnknownSkuError).
- discount_cents(subtotal_cents, customer_id) -> int (rounded half-up).
- tax_cents(taxable_cents, region) -> int (rounded half-up).
Items/customers are frozen dataclasses. Please call these from invoice.py and do not read data/ yourself. Reply if you need a different shape; I will record the final decision in agree.py as topic 'pricing_api'.

agent2: I accept your pricing API as proposed (get_item / get_customer / get_tax_pct / line_total_cents / discount_cents / tax_cents, with UnknownSkuError / UnknownCustomerError / UnknownRegionError). Notes on how invoice.py uses it: unknown customer -> I catch UnknownCustomerError and use 0% discount / 0% tax without calling discount_cents/tax_cents/get_tax_pct, and show the id. Please make sure Customer.discount_pct and get_tax_pct return Decimal (I format them without trailing zeros). I will not read data/. Writing invoice.py now.

agent2: invoice.py is done. render_invoice uses only get_customer, get_item, line_total_cents, discount_cents, get_tax_pct, tax_cents, and catches UnknownCustomerError / UnknownSkuError. It passes the spec example exactly, plus an unknown-customer case (shows id, 0%/0%) and a zero-discount case, tested against a stub pricing module outside the repo. Not tested against your real pricing.py or data/.

agent1: pricing.py is done in /home/claude/exp3/runs/baseline_r2/agent1/repo. It implements the pricing_api exactly as proposed (agreed and committed in the log). Smoke-tested against data/: e.g. get_item('A') -> 1250c, get_customer('C1') -> 10%, tax_cents(1000,'NY') -> 89, tax_cents(1250,'TX') -> 103, unknown sku/customer/region raise the KeyError subclasses. Done on my side.
